claims.statement: attach_section.mjs owns the AKSK ROUTING and LIFECYCLE zones via a single N-template mechanism: markers are parsed at runtime from the template file (markersOf reading AKSK:* BEGIN/END), existing content outside markers is never replaced or removed, reruns are idempotent (no-op when section matches or in-place refresh of only that marked block), missing target file is created containing only the attached section, and unknown template name exits 2.

A fully bootstrapped root AGENTS.md is a zoned file with three marker-delimited families ordered baseline → OpenWiki → AKSK: FerroxLabs behavioral baseline inside AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE, OpenWiki inside OPENWIKI:START/END, and AKSK routing (AKSK:ROUTING) plus lifecycle (AKSK:LIFECYCLE), each with exactly one block and strict marker ownership; in this repo AGENTS.md is already seeded with the baseline at the top followed by OPENWIKI and the two AKSK blocks.

The FerroxLabs baseline is vendored offline at .agents/skills/aksk-init/references/agents-md-baseline-template.md (mirrored at .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/references/agents-md-baseline-template.md) with its body wrapped in AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE markers and a provenance header inside the block containing upstream source URL, capture date, MIT license notice, and refresh pointer; seeding copies the vendored block verbatim with no network access.

init_agents_md.mjs owns the baseline zone: it creates a missing AGENTS.md from the vendored template, is idempotent via trailing-whitespace-normalized compare (no-op when marked section matches), and on conflict with an existing non-matching file exits 2 without writes printing the replace-vs-combine question; --replace overwrites with the marked baseline including header and --combine stages existing content, baseline, and a COMBINE.md brief under .agents/sessions/agents-md-combine/<timestamp>/, never modifying the original itself.

refresh_agents_baseline.mjs is the opt-in vendored-baseline updater: it fetches upstream to a temp file, validates non-empty and expected section anchors, swaps only content between AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE markers and updates provenance date leaving OpenWiki and AKSK zones byte-identical; offline or validation failure exits non-zero with remediation and leaves the previously vendored baseline intact.

Bootstrap composition order is deterministic: init_agents_md.mjs seeds the baseline first, then OpenWiki attaches its OPENWIKI:START/END block below baseline, then attach_section.mjs appends ROUTING and LIFECYCLE below OpenWiki and attach_wiki_contract.mjs appends the wiki contract to openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md; per-repo order is enforced by bootstrap-repo.mjs (global lane by bootstrap-global.mjs) and each script is idempotent so reruns after a template change only touch the zone whose template changed.

The behavioral baseline lives in root AGENTS.md as a scoped exception to the thin-router invariant: the routing-pattern decision requires root files to stay thin and route repo knowledge to .agents/ and openwiki/, but the FerroxLabs baseline is a behavioral operating contract not repo knowledge; routing and lifecycle blocks still attach below it to preserve single source of truth.

Zone isolation and marker integrity are load-bearing: docs-lint integrity-checks each family independently (AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE with provenance source URL, AKSK:ROUTING/LIFECYCLE exactly-one and targets exist, OPENWIKI presence-only, AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT in openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md), refresh or combine keeps other zones byte-identical, combine preserves project-specific learnings and keeps marker blocks verbatim, and a stale vendored capture date (>6 months) is surfaced as informational advice.

attach_wiki_contract.mjs owns the AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT zone in openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md using the same N-template marker protocol: it never creates the file and fails fast with exit 2 and the openwiki --init prerequisite when INSTRUCTIONS.md is missing, is idempotent via trimmed compare and refreshes only the marked block in place when the template changed, never touches OpenWiki-owned content outside markers, and reports stub-aware attachment when below the default stub.

In this checkout root AGENTS.md carries hand-authored behavioral content without AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE markers followed by OPENWIKI and AKSK blocks, which is the pre-seed state where a no-flag init_agents_md.mjs run fails closed with the replace-vs-combine prompt instead of seeding.

Root AGENTS.md is the agent entrypoint whose AKSK:ROUTING block routes durable repo guidance to .agents/AGENTS.md and whose AKSK:LIFECYCLE summary defers to .agents/AGENTS.md for the full loop, while .agents/AGENTS.md itself is marker-free portable repo knowledge holding routing directives, project learnings, and the analyze-closeout-distill-prune loop.
